words.example: The delay is above the average.
words.notes: on average 是平均而言。by an average of 是平均相差某個幅度。

words.example: The backlog is thirty orders.
words.notes: 尚未處理的工作，也可指存貨。backlog control 是存量控制。

words.example: The first batch leaves on Monday.
words.notes: 一組、一批。a batch of 是一批。

words.example: Do not blame the driver for the dent.
words.notes: blame sb for 是因某事責怪某人。be to blame 是該受責備。

words.example: The bulk of the order is cotton.
words.notes: 大的體積或大量。in bulk 是大量地、散裝。

words.example: The cable around the crate is loose.
words.notes: 纜繩或電纜。

words.example: In this case the crate stays closed.
words.exampleZh: 這種情況箱子先不要開。
words.notes: 情況、案例，也可指箱子。in case 是以防萬一。in any case 是無論如何。

words.example: The checklist names every carton.
words.notes: 核對用的清單。一個字。

words.example: The consignor address is on the label.
words.notes: 發貨、委託運送的人。consignee 是收貨人。

words.example: The container is short one pallet.
words.notes: 貨櫃或容器。也稱集裝箱。

words.example: The crane cannot lift this crate.
words.exampleZh: 起重機吊不起這個箱子。
words.notes: 起重機。另一個意思是鶴。

words.example: The delivery date is Thursday.
words.notes: 發送、遞送。delivery date 是交貨日期。

words.example: There is a dent in the door.
words.notes: 名詞是凹痕。動詞是把某物壓出凹痕。

words.example: The route will depend on the port.
words.notes: depend on 是依靠或取決於。

words.example: Leave the spare cartons in the depository.
words.exampleZh: 多餘的紙箱放在存放處。
words.notes: 儲藏室、倉庫。

words.example: Dispatch the second lot today.
words.notes: 動詞是發送、派遣。名詞是急件，或發送這個動作。

words.example: The e-commerce order left the warehouse.
words.exampleZh: 這筆電子商務訂單已經離倉。
words.notes: 中間有連字號。線上交易。

words.example: The embargo stopped the shipment.
words.notes: 名詞是禁令、禁運。動詞是禁運。under embargo 是被禁運。

words.example: Encode each carton before it leaves.
words.notes: 把資料編成代碼。encoding 是編碼。

words.example: The fake label peeled off.
words.notes: 名詞是假貨。形容詞是偽造的。

words.example: A false weight will fail the check.
words.exampleZh: 重量不實就過不了檢查。
words.notes: 錯誤的、不真實的。a false friend 是不可靠的朋友，另一個意思。

words.example: The freight is billed to the buyer.
words.notes: 運送的貨物，或運費。air freight 是空運。

words.example: The freighter sails on Friday.
words.notes: 貨船。也可指承運貨物的人。

words.example: These are genuine parts, not copies.
words.exampleZh: 這些是真品零件，不是仿的。
words.notes: 真正的、真誠的。

words.example: The goods are already on the truck.
words.notes: 複數形式，動詞常用複數。一批貨物。

words.example: Guard the dock while the truck is open.
words.exampleZh: 卡車開著的時候，看著碼頭。
words.notes: 動詞是保護、看守。名詞是警衛。on guard 是站崗、提防。

words.example: Send an hourly update until it ships.
words.exampleZh: 出貨前每小時回報一次。
words.notes: 每小時一次。hourly rate 是時薪。

words.example: The identification on the crate is wrong.
words.exampleZh: 箱子上的識別資料錯了。
words.notes: 鑑定、識別。identification of 是對某物的識別。

words.example: The indent asks for forty units.
words.notes: 名詞常指訂貨單。動詞也可指做成鋸齒狀。

words.example: The inventory does not match the pick list.
words.exampleZh: 存貨清單和揀貨單對不上。
words.notes: 名詞是庫存清單。動詞是列清單、盤點。

words.example: Lade the heavy crates first.
words.notes: 裝貨，也可指汲取。過去分詞 laden 是不規則變化，例句用原形。

words.example: Lengthen the rope before you lift.
words.notes: 使變長。lengthen out 是延長。

words.example: A lengthy delay needs a new date.
words.notes: 冗長的、漫長的。

words.example: One limitation is the truck height.
words.notes: limitation on 是對某事的限制。without limitation 是沒有限制。

words.example: Do not ship the liquid in this crate.
words.notes: 形容詞是液體的。名詞是液體。

words.example: Logistics moved the pickup to noon.
words.notes: 物流。動詞可用單數或複數。logistics service 是物流服務。

words.example: Only a minority of the boxes are light.
words.notes: 少數。a minority of 後面動詞可用複數。也可指未成年。

words.example: I have one misgiving about the route.
words.exampleZh: 我對這條路線有一點疑慮。
words.notes: 擔心、顧慮。常用複數 misgivings。

words.example: On this occasion the truck was early.
words.notes: on occasion 是有時。take occasion 是利用機會。

words.example: They occasionally ship on Saturday.
words.notes: 有時、偶爾。

words.example: Order the replacement before noon.
words.notes: 動詞是訂購或命令。名詞是訂單，也可指秩序。in order 是妥當、按順序。

words.example: The parcel left the desk at three.
words.notes: 名詞是包裹。動詞是打包。

words.example: This part is out of stock.
words.notes: 名詞是部分或零件。動詞是分開。part of 後面的動詞視前面的名詞而定。

words.example: They will accept a partial shipment.
words.notes: 部分的。另一個意思是偏愛某一方。partial to 是偏愛。

words.example: Payment follows the shipping papers.
words.notes: 支付。down payment 是頭款。

words.example: Run a periodic check of the dock.
words.notes: 週期的、定期的。

words.example: Pick the red cartons first.
words.notes: 挑選或摘取。pick sth up 是撿起，或接人。

words.example: The pipe in the crate was bent.
words.notes: 名詞是管子，也可指煙斗。動詞是用管道輸送。

words.example: The ship stays in port until dawn.
words.notes: 港口。也可指機場。in port 是在港內。

words.example: A practical route avoids the low bridge.
words.exampleZh: 可行的路線會避開那座矮橋。
words.notes: 實際的、實用的。practical idea 是可行的想法。

words.example: The price includes the crate.
words.notes: 名詞是價格。動詞是標價。price sth at 是把某物標為某個價錢。

words.example: They promise delivery on Friday.
words.notes: promise to do 是答應做某事。promise sb sth 是答應給某人某物。

words.example: Protect the corners before you stack them.
words.exampleZh: 疊上去之前先把角保護好。
words.notes: protect sth from 是保護某物免於某事。

words.example: The quantity on the label is wrong.
words.notes: 數量。a quantity of 是若干。in quantity 是大量地。

words.example: Do not pick cartons at random.
words.notes: at random 是隨機地。形容詞是任意的。

words.example: The rope is too short for this crate.
words.exampleZh: 這條繩子對這個箱子來說太短。
words.notes: 繩索。

words.example: They could salvage only the dry cartons.
words.exampleZh: 他們只搶救出沒有濕掉的紙箱。
words.notes: 搶救貨物或海上救難。salvage charges 是搶救費用。

words.example: The shipment is ready at dock two.
words.exampleZh: 這批貨在二號碼頭準備好了。
words.notes: 裝運，或運出的一批貨。

words.example: Use shockproof wrap for the glass.
words.notes: 一個字，中間沒有連字號。

words.example: The pallet needs a solid base.
words.notes: 形容詞是結實的、固體的。名詞是固體。

words.example: Sort the returns by size.
words.notes: 名詞是種類。動詞是分類。sort of 是有點、某種。

words.example: The sorting starts at six.
words.notes: 把貨物挑開、分類的作業。

words.example: Stack the light boxes on top.
words.notes: 動詞是堆積。名詞是一堆，也可指草堆。

words.example: The storehouse is full.
words.notes: 存放貨物的倉庫。

words.example: A tracking number is tangible proof it left.
words.exampleZh: 追蹤號碼是貨已離倉的具體證明。
words.notes: 摸得到的，或明確、具體的。

words.example: The trailer is at gate three.
words.notes: 拖在車後的拖車。也可指預告片。

words.example: The goods are in transit.
words.notes: in transit 是在運輸中。

words.example: We transport glass in upright racks.
words.exampleZh: 玻璃我們用直立架運送。
words.notes: 動詞是運送。名詞是運輸，或交通工具。

words.example: Transportation stops on Sunday.
words.notes: 運輸這件事，或交通。

words.example: The truck is too high for the dock.
words.exampleZh: 這輛卡車對這個碼頭來說太高。
words.notes: 貨車、卡車。

words.example: We undertake to ship by Friday.
words.exampleZh: 我們負責在星期五前出貨。
words.notes: undertake to do 是承諾做某事。過去式 undertook、過去分詞 undertaken 是不規則變化。

words.example: Unload the truck before the rain.
words.notes: 卸下貨物。也可指去除負擔。

words.example: They vend the surplus at the gate.
words.exampleZh: 多餘的貨他們在門口賣。
words.notes: 出售、販賣。

words.example: The vessel is already at the buoy.
words.notes: 船，也可指容器或血管。

words.example: The crates vibrate on this road.
words.exampleZh: 走這條路時箱子會振動。
words.notes: 振動、擺動。

words.example: The vibration cracked two jars.
words.exampleZh: 振動把兩個罐子震裂了。
words.notes: 振動。vibration frequency 是振動頻率。

words.example: The wagon blocked the ramp.
words.notes: 運貨的車廂或貨車。

words.example: The wrap is waterproof.
words.notes: 一個字。waterproof cloth 是防水布。
